explanation: Fires on technical terms in physical-science/continuum-modelling text that denote a small spatial element or resolution scale: "[finite] strain", "a [parcel] of surface air", "vort[icity]", "co[arser] computational grids", "ed[dy]-resolving", "[resolved] pixel size", "same[-size] units", "submicroscopic [dust]", and the word "point" opening a math problem ("A [point] $(x,y)$").
